papers.why: per-token temperature at code-block starts judged on pass@k; no counterfactually located decision token, no committed dose prediction, no algorithm-choice outcome; our A6 arm implements its rule (T 2 ...

papers.title: EDT: Improving Large Language Models' Generation by Entropy-based Dynamic Temperature Sampling
papers.why: temperature chosen per step from the next-token entropy; position chosen by entropy, not by a counterfactual locator; our A5 (threshold EDT) and A7 (entropy-max at matched dose) arms
papers.quote: a better balance between generation quality and diversity by choosing the temperature parameter dynamically

papers.title: Control the Temperature: Selective Sampling for Diverse and High-Quality LLM Outputs
papers.why: learned risk score switches greedy vs high-T per token for math reasoning; risk avoidance, not dosed idea mixing at a located fork
papers.quote: switches between greedy and high-temperature sampling based on a sampling risk metric
